caption: The video captures a wide, low-angle view of a flat grassland plain beneath a massive, dark cumulonimbus cloud that fills most of the sky, with a small mesa on the left horizon and a warm golden band of light along the right. The horizon and foreground grassland remain steady, so the visible motion comes from the evolving cloud and precipitation rather than a pan. The dark cloud mass is already churning and continues to reorganize, its internal lobes and shading shifting gradually instead of sliding as a rigid block. Across the left portion of the cloud, streaky radiating bands fan diagonally toward the center, growing progressively more defined. On the right, a vertical rain curtain hangs from the cloud base, transitioning from a darker, uniform sheet into a broader, lighter, diffuse veil. Near the center of the horizon, a brighter, light-catching patch of precipitation softens and shifts slightly within this curtain. As the precipitation area spreads, the dark cloud outline on the right lifts and softens against the lighter rain veil, altering the silhouette. The deformation and spread of the storm features continue steadily, with no clear beginning or resolution visible.
relations: Churning cloud lobes gradually reorganize and shift internally rather than sliding as a rigid mass.
Left-side streaky bands fan diagonally toward the center, growing progressively more defined over time.
The right rain curtain broadens and lightens, lifting and softening the dark cloud outline above it.
A bright precipitation patch near the center horizon softens and shifts within the spreading rain veil.
